payload.description:
Add an LLM distillation step that extracts a normalized structured artifact (entities + findings) from each accepted reference, embed THAT instead of raw composite text, and write the entities as filterable vector metadata. This is Cerebras's biggest accuracy win ("accuracy increased significantly when the thread was normalized into a consistent format") adapted to threat intel. Highest ceiling of all the epics; largest build.

## Current state (verified 2026-07-19)

- Distillation is ~40% built. `reference_summary` vectors already embed a composite: title + subtitle + canonical LLM summary + authors + sourceUri + first 2,400 chars (`_prepare_source_vector`, `src/papyrus_knowledge_query/vector_index.py:673-717`). The summary comes from `procedures/newsroom/reference_summarization.tac` and is read from the reference metadata attachment (`vector_index.py:857-874` region — locate `reference_summary_payload` resolution).
- ZERO entity extraction exists — grep for CVE in `src/` returns nothing.
- The persistence pattern to clone: `ModelAttachment` rows on references (see `src/papyrus_content/model_attachments.py`; summarization already persists artifacts this way). Versioning convention: `promptVersion` fields already appear in the summary payload metadata (`vector_index.py:784`).
- Ontology home for phase 2: `SemanticNode` (nodeKey, aliases, authorityScore) + `mentions` relation (`src/papyrus_newsroom/semantic.py:39`).
- Metadata sanitizer: `_sanitize_vector_metadata` (`vector_index.py:1275-1300` region) — verify it handles arrays of strings before relying on it.
- CLI patterns to clone: `references summarize` (find in `src/papyrus_newsroom/references_commands.py` / `reference_actions.py`).

## Design decisions (already made — do not relitigate)

1. **New procedure `procedures/newsroom/reference_distillation.tac`**, cloned from the `reference_summarization.tac` pattern (same model tier, same dry-run/persistence split — the CLI owns persistence, the procedure returns a payload).
2. **Artifact schema (versioned, `promptVersion: 1`)**: `{summary, key_findings: [str], cves: [str], threat_actors: [str], malware_families: [str], affected_products: [str], attack_techniques: [str], iocs: {hashes: [str], domains: [str], ips: [str]}, report_type: str, source_org: str}`.
3. **Anti-hallucination validation (non-negotiable)**: after extraction, every CVE, hash, domain, IP, and ATT&CK ID must appear VERBATIM in the extracted source text (compare after defang normalization: hxxp→http, [.]→., etc.). Drop non-matching values and log them. `threat_actors`/`malware_families` are exempt (aliases are legitimately inferred) but capped at 10 each.
4. **Persistence**: one `ModelAttachment` with role `distillation` per reference, JSON body, following the summarization attachment pattern exactly. New CLI command `references distill` with the same selection flags as `references summarize`.
5. **Index side**: in `_prepare_source_vector`, when a distillation artifact exists, embed `title + subtitle + summary + key_findings + entity lists (labeled)` instead of the current composite; otherwise FALL BACK to current behavior (corpus can be partially distilled). Write entity arrays into vector metadata as filterable arrays: `cves`, `threatActors`, `malwareFamilies`, `affectedProducts`, `attackTechniques`. Cap array sizes before writing (cves ≤ 20, others ≤ 10) — S3 Vectors has per-vector filterable-metadata size limits; the implementer MUST check the current AWS limit and add a total-size guard with truncation.
6. **Query side**: extend `_metadata_filter` (`services.py:397-433`) to map scope keys `cves`/`threatActors`/`malwareFamilies` etc. to `$in`-style filters, and pass them through `_normalize_request`'s accepted scope keys. This enables "everything accepted that mentions this actor" queries and feeds the scope-bundles epic.
7. **Re-run policy**: distill once per accepted reference; re-run only on `promptVersion` bump or `--force`. Cost is one-time per document and throttled by curation — this is our cost governor; keep it that way.
8. **Phase 2 (separate follow-up task, not this epic's DoD)**: emit `mentions` SemanticRelations to entity SemanticNodes.

## Files to modify

- NEW `procedures/newsroom/reference_distillation.tac`.
- `src/papyrus_newsroom/reference_actions.py` (or a sibling module) — distill action: fetch text, run procedure, validate entities, persist attachment.
- `src/papyrus_newsroom/references_commands.py` + CLI wiring — `references distill`.
- `src/papyrus_knowledge_query/vector_index.py` — read distillation attachment (mirror the summary-payload resolution), embed distilled text, write entity metadata with caps.
- `src/papyrus_knowledge_query/services.py` + `engine.py` — entity scope filters.
- Tests: entity-validation unit tests (hallucinated CVE dropped; defanged IOC matches fanged source), fallback-when-absent test, metadata-cap test, filter-passthrough test.

## What could go wrong

- **Hallucinated entities are the #1 risk** — the verbatim-presence check is the mitigation; do not ship without it. Log drop counts so prompt quality is observable.
- **Metadata size limits**: entity-rich references (vendor reports listing 50 CVEs) can blow per-vector filterable metadata limits and fail the whole put. The total-size guard with truncation is mandatory; test with an oversized synthetic artifact.
- **Embedding input changes → full corpus re-embed.** COORDINATE: batch this rebuild with the contextual-chunks epic (one re-embed, not two). Until the rebuild, old vectors serve fine (fallback path).
- **Partial corpora**: some references distilled, some not, for a long time. Every consumer must handle absence gracefully (fallback embed path, absent metadata keys).
- **Prompt/JSON failures**: the procedure must validate JSON shape with a bounded retry (the 3-attempt validation-retry pattern exists in `research_explorer.tac` — reuse it), and the CLI must skip-and-report failures rather than aborting a batch.
- **Tactus procedure conventions**: keep the dry-run contract (procedures never write records); persistence lives in the CLI action. Violating this breaks the newsroom's audit model.

## Out of scope

SemanticNode/graph emission (phase 2 follow-up), alias canonicalization across references, re-embedding the corpus (batched with contextual-chunks epic), any auto-acceptance of references.
payload.title: Reference distillation: entity extraction + filterable metadata
